summary: 100 ft Aermotor tower in Clay County, MS, registered by NHLR in 2022 as US 1674. No build date, staffing or fire history found; a 2020 state list conflicts with the register's private-property note.

access.note: NHLR describes the tower as on private property. A 2020 state list shows a Clay County Tower under the Forestry Commission, which we could not confirm is this structure.

events.note: Registered July 10, 2022 as US 1674, MS 37; nominated by Jason Johns
Listed as Clay County Tower under Forestry Commission, State, in a Secretary of State public lands list dated July 29, 2020. Identity with this tower unconfirmed.

evidence.supports: administered by the Mississippi Forestry Commission

notes_for_editor: Only the NHLR detail page and the 2020 Secretary of State public lands list were read. Two web searches and the Forest Fire Lookout Association Mississippi page found nothing local; that FFLA page says its Mississippi data is still under construction. The cdispatch.com article returned HTTP 410 and was not used. The register does not say outright that the tower is standing, so status is recorded as unknown; neither the register description nor the 2020 list confirms it. The access level private rests only on the register note. The conflict is open: the register says private property, while the state list places a Clay County Tower under the Forestry Commission. The state list may refer to a different site or the land may have changed hands, but neither is verified. Suggested next step: ask the Mississippi Forestry Commission about the tower and its owner, and check Clay County parcel records.
